units.summary: Face the player, approach within a $50 tolerance and stop X motion. units.name: DamagePlayerForTerrainContact
units.summary: Deal eight damage and enter the common response.

units.name: UpdateTerrainFollowingEntity
units.summary: Contact uses the shared damage path. Otherwise compare player height/private state, obtain a platform-derived Y velocity, and choose signed horizontal motion from player separation. units.name: DamagePlayerForBoundedContact
units.summary: Deal eight damage and enter contact response.

units.name: UpdateSeventyPixelFollower
units.summary: Choose signed one-pixel horizontal targets around a 70-pixel player separation. At the threshold stop and select descriptor $A49F; otherwise select $A493 with facing from current velocity.

units.name: DamagePlayerForAnimatedContact
units.summary: Apply eight damage before contact response.

units.name: UpdateAnimatedChildAttack
units.summary: Use frame 1 and the adjacent-slot vacancy to launch a child on the facing side. Other nonzero frames restore descriptor $A493 when the child slot is free.

units.name: UpdateShortRangeApproach
units.summary: Approach the player with target $0178 and tolerance eight. Choose descriptor $A443 from velocity direction; one path also creates the stationary paired effect through the shared helper.

units.name: UpdateSceneSpecificApproach
units.summary: Approach as above, but scene descriptor $B9C9 and vertical-velocity sign select descriptor $A473 versus $A437. The lower path creates the paired effect; exact character identity is unresolved.

units.name: DamagePlayerForAlternateAttack
units.summary: Apply eight damage and enter the common contact response.

units.name: UpdateAlternateAnimatedAttack
units.summary: Use frame and facing to launch the common child attack; when the child is free on later frames, restore descriptor $A437.

units.name: LaunchChildLeft
units.summary: Place the next slot at (-16,-22), give it horizontal velocity $01D0 and vertical velocity $FD40, set a forty-frame private timer and install descriptor $A4B5.

units.name: LaunchChildRight
units.summary: Mirror child placement to (+16,-22) and horizontal velocity $FE30. Preserve the same vertical impulse, private timer and descriptor.

units.name: TickChildAndMove
units.summary: Decrement the selected private timer when active, then enter the shared movement updater.

units.name: NmiHandler
units.summary: Save registers and advance a 16-bit frame counter. Optionally DMA shadow OAM, apply CHR bank shadows and drain PPU commands. Restore scroll/rendering/mirroring, arm scanline IRQ, poll controllers and call a banked frame callback, then update sound and restore the interrupted bank/registers. Queue flag bit 0 selects a ROM-pointer copy; otherwise bytes are inline. Bit 2 selects PPU increment direction.
